# Tacticity Advisors

> U.S. FDA regulatory strategy consultancy for medical device, IVD and SaMD companies, based in Pune, India. Founded by Tanmay Jain, PhD, a former U.S. FDA CDRH scientist and lead reviewer. Services cover FDA pathway strategy, 510(k)/De Novo/PMA/Q-Submissions, ISO 10993 biocompatibility, chemical characterization (E&L), testing strategy, quality system compliance, and FDA deficiency and enforcement response. Tacticity Capital, the investment arm, invests in healthcare and medtech companies.

Contact: contact@tacticityadvisors.com. To request a consultation, use the inquiry form at https://tacticityadvisors.com/contact.html (required: first name, last name, email, company, country; optional: phone, job title, area of inquiry, details).

## Services
- [Regulatory Strategy](https://tacticityadvisors.com/regulatory-strategy.html): Device classification, choosing between 510(k), De Novo and PMA, and a submission-ready plan.
- [Premarket Submissions](https://tacticityadvisors.com/premarket-submissions.html): Preparation and support for 510(k), De Novo, PMA and Q-Submissions.
- [Biocompatibility](https://tacticityadvisors.com/biocompatibility.html): Risk-based ISO 10993 biological safety evaluation and chemical characterization for FDA submissions.
- [Testing Strategy](https://tacticityadvisors.com/testing-strategy.html): Evidence planning and CRO protocol and report review before committing test budget.
- [Quality and Compliance](https://tacticityadvisors.com/quality-compliance.html): Quality system and QMSR compliance support for manufacturers.
- [Enforcement Response](https://tacticityadvisors.com/enforcement-response.html): Form 483, warning letter and FDA deficiency response and remediation.
- [Services overview](https://tacticityadvisors.com/services.html): All FDA regulatory services from first submission to lifecycle management.

## Company
- [What we do](https://tacticityadvisors.com/what-we-do.html): Approach to science-led regulatory strategy.
- [How we work](https://tacticityadvisors.com/how-we-work.html): Engagement model from early development to FDA response.
- [Team](https://tacticityadvisors.com/team.html): Leadership and scientific advisors.
- [Investments](https://tacticityadvisors.com/investments.html): Tacticity Capital, regulatory diligence for funds and support for portfolio companies.
- [Contact](https://tacticityadvisors.com/contact.html): Schedule an FDA regulatory consultation.
